title: Unique Happy Ghasts
body:
This simple datapack **modifies the flying speed and scale atrributes of every Happy Ghast** with a random value and is optimized for 1.21.6 to 1.21.11. This pack changes:
- Flying speed from default 0.05 to a range from 0.0525 to 0.1.
- The Happy Ghasts smaller scale attribute randomly from 0.8 to 1.

If you find an error or are just curious, check my Discord server.
